# Polar

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A dark billing and merchant-of-record marketing site: polar grey page (#181818), near-black nav (#090909), white pill primary, PP Neue Montreal at weight 450, and a signed-out auth wall with Google, Apple, GitHub and an email field.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing and the auth wall only. https://polar.sh/signup redirects to https://polar.sh/auth. The form was not submitted. Google, Apple and GitHub were not followed. No card, bank or KYC step was entered.. Themes: light, dark.

Polar (polar.sh) is a billing platform and merchant of record for software. This package records the public marketing site and the signed-out login chrome, measured on 2026-11-19 from a live T3 preview tab. No account was created. No card, bank, or KYC step was entered. The signup wall at https://polar.sh/auth was recorded as a gap.

The live CSS viewport was 1169 by 731 at devicePixelRatio 2. The product's marketing pages ship with `html` class `antialiased dark`. Docs at https://polar.sh/docs/introduction also have a light theme, measured after clicking "Switch to light theme", then restored to dark.

## Typography

6 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Inter, PP Neue Montreal.

### Fonts (from README.md)

PP Neue Montreal is the marketing face (`--font-sans` and `--font-display`), with Inter and InterDisplay as the next families. GeistMono is the marketing mono. Docs body is Inter. Docs code is Paper Mono, then ui-monospace. These families are named as computed. The font files are not in this package. Tokens fall back to Inter, sans-serif, and ui-monospace.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The CSS viewport was 1169, not 1440 and not 390. Do not treat these readings as a 1440 or 390 capture. The light semantic set is the docs shell, not a light marketing theme. Marketing `html` stayed `dark`. A light marketing theme was not found. Button hover, focus-visible, pressed and disabled were named in class strings and were not shown, so they are not tokens. The auth secondary border was an oklab colour with alpha. It is recorded in components.md and not forced into a hex token. Screenshot folders are empty on purpose.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the dark marketing page.** The home, pricing, company, blog and auth pages render on `#181818` with white headings and a `#090909` nav. [patterns.md](patterns.md) describes that shell.
- **Use white pills for the primary action.** "Get Started" is a white pill with black text. "Sign in" is a transparent pill with white text. [components.md](components.md) lists the sizes.
- **Keep the signup wall as a wall.** https://polar.sh/auth offers Google, Apple, GitHub and email. Do not invent a signed-in dashboard behind it. [components.md](components.md) records the gap.
- **Use Inter on docs, PP Neue Montreal on marketing.** The two shells do not share a face. [tokens.json](tokens.json) keeps both stacks.
- **Do not invent a 1440 screenshot.** The preview browser produced no frames. [screenshots/](screenshots/) says so.
